checkout: Includes pre-existing uncommitted changes; these fingerprints were captured after the measurements.
notes: Local capacity and artificial latency experiments, not internet bandwidth tests.
Early 64 MiB relay baseline preceded heavy competing emulator and Java load.
Do not compare absolute speeds across invocations as controlled performance deltas.
Go CPU profiler was killed and generated no usable profile.
Invalid early harness runs are retained for audit and excluded from conclusions.
No production application code was changed.

artifacts.baseline-64.json: Early 64 MiB CLI/browser relay baseline, five trials per mode.
artifacts.network.json: Final latency matrix, three trials per mode per added ACK RTT, all verified.
artifacts.browser.json: Actual browser modules, CPU and staging measurements, three runs at each throttle.
artifacts.storage.json: Storage-only reopen versus persistent worker-handle experiment.
artifacts.direct-browser.json: First direct browser probe on a busy host.
artifacts.browser-routes-loaded.json: Later direct and relay browser probes in one invocation on a busy host.
artifacts.network-disk.json: Btrfs-backed CLI source, destination, and checkpoints, no added latency.
artifacts.go-bench.txt: Failed profiling attempt; SIGKILL, no usable measurements.
artifacts.network-invalid-proxy.json: Invalid initial harness run; proxy close ordering was wrong.
artifacts.network-partial-rate-limited.json: Early run exhausted local admission limit; not used for performance conclusions.
artifacts.report.html: Interactive findings, limitations, source locations, and reproduction commands.
